target.title: Give claude-swap accounts explicit precedence over Claude token-account cards
target.body:
## Summary

Follow-up to #1909 — this commit (`9738b10e` on the original branch) was pushed just before the squash-merge and missed the cut-off, leaving [this Codex review finding](https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/1909#discussion_r3525053079) unaddressed on main.

With multiple Claude token accounts configured and the multi-account layout set to stacked, the token-account branch in `addMenuCards` renders first and silently hides the claude-swap adapter's rows. Enabling the opt-in adapter declares claude-swap as the account source, so it now takes explicit precedence:

- `addMenuCards` renders claude-swap stacked cards before the token-account branch for Claude.
- `tokenAccountMenuDisplay(for:)` returns nil for Claude while adapter rows are active, so the segmented token-account switcher cannot render mixed with adapter cards either.
- Other providers' token-account presentation is untouched.

Also adds the packaged synthetic proof screenshot to `docs/claude.md` (fake `cswap` executable emitting schema-v1 fixtures — no real accounts, credentials, or provider calls):

![Stacked claude-swap account cards](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/optimiz-r/CodexBar/fix/claude-swap-token-account-precedence/docs/screenshots/claude-swap-accounts-synthetic-proof.png)

## Tests

- New `ClaudeSwapMenuPrecedenceTests`: adapter rows suppress Claude token-account display; single-row adapter state does not; other providers unaffected.
- Ran the menu/account/claude-swap suites (538 tests, 76 suites), `swiftformat` (no changes), `swiftlint --strict` (0 violations).

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
